answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The knoll is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the mirror. What survives to the horizon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
